t: Include the resolved max attempts in the ``amz-sdk-request`` header on the initial attempt
Fix backoff calculation for truncated binary exponential backoff (`#3178 <https://github.com/boto/botocore/issues/3178>`__)

Add ability to configure the maximum amount of retry attempts a client call can make. (`#1260 <https://github.com/boto/botocore/pull/1260>`__)
